answer: The relic is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the harbor. Reaching the yarrow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
